sources: Synthesis of posts by multi-account AI-UGC operators on X, mid-2026, supplied by the operator
provenance.note: HAND-WRITTEN AND SPECULATIVE. Distilled from operator consensus, not from platform documentation, and not measured on any account this fleet operates. Every range here is a starting hypothesis. Do not treat any number in this file as established practice. Revise from observations[] once real runs exist, and update confidence when you do.
provenance.revisit_trigger: After 5 identities complete this program with recorded gate measurements.

preconditions.note: One unique, persistent device fingerprint per identity. Never shared between identities.
Residential proxy pinned to a single region for the identity's whole life. No rotation mid-program; rotation is reported as one of the most common silent causes of permanent throttling.
Signup country code, store region, and proxy region all agree. A leak here is claimed to degrade distribution permanently rather than temporarily, and this scenario cannot detect it after the fact.
Niche-consistent handle and avatar. No bio link yet — link placement is gated until after graduation.

session_policy.note: Sessions are clustered deliberately. The same action counts spread evenly across a day produce a different behavioural signature from the same actions in two or three sittings.

phases.intent: Teach the classifier this is a real user in this niche. The first 24-72 hours are reported to be weighted heavily and difficult to undo afterwards.

steps.note: Watch to the end. Completion is the single most weighted signal in the source material.
Specific and genuine. Emoji-only comments are reported as worse than no comment. Text is authored per comment; this scenario deliberately does not generate it.
Search niche keywords and watch results to completion.

phases.intent: Same behaviour, sharper targeting. Deepen the niche signal before anything is posted.
One non-promotional value post, used purely to measure whether the account was categorized well.

steps.note: Pure value, niche-native. Unique asset only — duplicate media is hashed by the platform, so an asset published by another identity is a coordination signal.

outcomes.note: Reported as likely-flagged. The recommended action is to abandon this identity and rebuild with a tighter environment, NOT to continue the program.

gates.note: These thresholds are the least-validated numbers in this file. They are the operator consensus figure, not a measured boundary, and the gap between 500 and 1000 is a guess about where uncertainty lives.

graduation.note: This is what the eligibility query returns to content-desk. Elapsed days never qualify an identity on their own.

maintenance.note: Warming does not end at graduation. Niche engagement continues indefinitely, and it competes for the same daily cadence budget as posting.

gated_actions.note: Add a bio link only once distribution looks healthy for a week after graduation.

watch_metrics.note: Checked on the first real posts. A low target-geo share suggests the environment leaked even though the account was never flagged.

portfolio_constraints.note: Cross-identity rather than per-identity. Prevents a coordinated-looking posting pattern across the portfolio, and prevents the same rendered asset going out twice.
